title: IE Executive
description:
**Job Title: I**
E Executive

**Industry:**
Garment / Apparel Manufacturing

**Department:**
Industrial Engineering

**Experience:**
2–3 Years

**Work Location:**
Tirupur, Tamil Nadu

**Job Purpose**

To support the Brand Industrial Engineering function through SMV calculation, Line layout planning and analysis, Method improvement, and Video study with a strong focus on productivity, efficiency improvement, and continuous SMV reduction.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. SMV & Method Study**

* Develop, analyse, and maintain accurate SMVs for garment products.
* Strong understanding of SMV calculation, Operation Breakdown, Work Measurement, and Sewing Methods.
* Identify and implement improved sewing methods to reduce operation time and improve productivity.
* Continuously identify opportunities for SMV reduction through better methods, Machine attachments, and Work aids.
* Study best sewing methods in vendor factories and support implementation across other factories.
* Knowledge of SMV/IE software will be an added advantage.

**2. Line Layout Planning & Analysis**

* Prepare production line layouts based on SMV, operation breakdown, manpower, machine requirements, and achievable production targets.
* Review and improve layouts based on actual production performance.
* Visit vendor factories to verify implementation of approved line layouts.
* Check actual manpower allocation, machine positioning, operation sequence, and production flow against the approved layout.
* Monitor target achievement, line efficiency, productivity, and bottlenecks.
* Identify gaps between planned and actual performance and follow up with factory teams for corrective action.

**3. Video Study**

* Regularly visit vendor factories to conduct video/motion studies for products and operations.
* Analyse operator movements, operation methods, handling, and unnecessary motions.
* Identify the most efficient sewing methods and use findings to support SMV validation and reduction.
* Maintain records of improved methods and share best practices across factories.

**Key Requirements**

* 2–3 years' relevant experience in Garment Industrial Engineering.
* Strong practical knowledge of SMV, Line layout planning, method study, line balancing, and productivity improvement.
* Good understanding of garment sewing operations and manufacturing processes.
* Experience in conducting video/motion studies is preferred.
* Knowledge of SMV/IE software is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, observation, communication, and follow-up skills.
* Must be willing to travel regularly to vendor factories.

title: VICE PRESIDENT – KNITS PROCESSING
description:
To lead the techno-commercial operations of the knits processing division by driving business
  
  
growth, strengthening customer relationships, improving operational efficiency, and
  
  
expanding market presence across domestic and export segments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Marketing & Business Development**
Drive business development and customer acquisition in knit processing
  
  
Build strong networking and customer relationships in and around Tirupur
  
  
Handle key customer discussions, negotiations, and commercial activities
  
  
Develop and implement effective marketing strategies for business growth
  
  
**Operations & Production Management**
Oversee end-to-end processing operations and production performance
  
  
Ensure production planning, quality standards, and timely delivery
  
  
Improve operational efficiency, productivity, and process performance
  
  
Coordinate closely with production, quality, and commercial teams
  
  
**Techno-Commercial Leadership**
Manage commercial planning, costing, and profitability initiatives
  
  
Support pricing strategies and business expansion activities
  
  
Ensure smooth coordination between marketing, operations, and management
  
  
Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives
  
  
**Team & Customer Management**
Lead cross-functional teams across operations and marketing
  
  
Maintain strong customer satisfaction through service and quality excellence
  
  
Build long-term business relationships with buyers and exporters
  
  
**Key Skills Required**
Strong hands-on marketing skills in textile processing industry
  
  
Excellent networking capabilities in and around Tirupur textile market
  
  
Strong knowledge of knits processing operations and production management
  
  
Good exposure to business development and marketing strategies
  
  
Strong commercial, negotiation, and customer handling skills
  
  
Excellent leadership and team coordination abilities
  
  
**Experience Requirement**
Minimum 15-20 years of experience in textile processing industry
  
  
Strong exposure in knit processing, operations, and marketing functions
  
  
**Qualifications**
Experience handling domestic and export customers preferred
  
  
Bachelor’s Degree in Textile / Engineering / Business / Commerce MBA preferred
